title: Flutter Components Library
description: Open source collection of reusable Flutter widgets and components designed to accelerate mobile app development. Includes custom animations, form widgets, and UI components following Material Design principles.

title: .NET Core API Template
description: Comprehensive boilerplate project template for .NET Core Web API development. Includes authentication, logging, database integration, API documentation, and deployment configurations.

title: Islamic Prayer Times API
description: RESTful API service providing accurate Islamic prayer times calculations for any location worldwide. Supports multiple calculation methods and includes Qibla direction calculations.

title: Mobile Development Best Practices
description: Comprehensive guide and code examples for Flutter mobile development best practices. Covers architecture patterns, state management, testing, and performance optimization.

title: SQL Server Utilities
description: Collection of useful SQL Server scripts, stored procedures, and utilities for database administration and development. Includes performance monitoring and optimization tools.

title: Web Development Starter Kit
description: Modern web development starter template with build tools, CSS framework, JavaScript utilities, and deployment configurations. Designed for rapid prototyping and development.
